actions.action: Store competing definitions as separate sourced records
actions.mechanism: Separate term identity from definition wording so disagreement never requires overwriting another definition.
actions.implementation: Create term, passage, and definition tables. Require each definition’s passage ID to resolve within the supplied passage collection.
actions.check: Save two conflicting definitions for one term; verify both survive. Reject saves with missing or unknown passage IDs.
actions.risk: Editors may mistakenly create duplicate terms instead of variants.

actions.action: Show the source beside each definition
actions.mechanism: An inline source viewer lets readers inspect evidence without losing their place in the glossary.
actions.implementation: Add a source button displaying the linked passage ID and exact supplied text beside the definition; support keyboard opening and closing.
actions.check: Open every definition’s source button and compare displayed text with its stored passage. Verify keyboard focus returns correctly.
actions.risk: Long passages can overwhelm the reading layout.

actions.mechanism: Dispute records connect competing definitions and explanations without selecting a winner or merging their wording.
actions.implementation: Attach disputes to definition IDs. Display a disagreement badge opening both wordings, their passage IDs, and editor-entered explanations.
actions.check: Create a dispute between two definitions; verify readers can inspect both sources and unchanged wordings from either definition.
actions.risk: An unexplained badge may imply more disagreement than documented.

actions.mechanism: Versioned edits preserve earlier wording and its evidence instead of silently replacing a disputed definition.
actions.implementation: Write edits as new revisions carrying source passage IDs. Keep previous revisions readable; distinguish revising one definition from adding a competing definition.
actions.check: Revise a disputed definition twice; verify all wordings, source links, and the original dispute targets remain inspectable.
actions.risk: Revision history can become difficult to navigate.

actions.action: Flag definitions when supplied passages change
actions.mechanism: Immutable passage versions prevent source corrections from silently changing the evidence behind existing wording.
actions.implementation: Assign corrected passages new IDs linked to their predecessors. Keep definitions bound to original IDs and queue affected definitions for editor review.
actions.check: Replace a supplied passage; verify existing definitions still open the original and show a review flag until explicitly reviewed.
actions.risk: Frequent corrections can accumulate unresolved review work.

actions.action: Keep competing wording visible in search
actions.mechanism: Variant-aware retrieval prevents the default definition from hiding alternatives during term lookup.
actions.implementation: Index every retained definition’s wording. Group results by term, show disagreement counts, and expand matching variants with their passage IDs.
actions.check: Search a phrase appearing only in a competing definition; verify its term, wording, disagreement, and source are reachable.
actions.risk: Historical variants may clutter results unless clearly labeled.

actions.mechanism: Bundling definitions, competing wording, disputes, and supplied passages preserves inspectability outside the editor without external dependencies.
actions.implementation: Generate a static review page containing all current variants, dispute explanations, and linked passage sections. Block export on unresolved passage references.
actions.check: Open the package offline; verify every definition reaches its exact passage and every recorded disagreement exposes all participating wordings.
actions.risk: Exported packages become stale after subsequent edits.
